work.title: Spoons and Discs Totem
work.description: Vertically symmetrical collage built from layered found objects including wooden spoons, compact discs, orange vinyl records, red vertical stripes, and hardware elements. Small photographic portrait appears near the bottom center amid dense accumulations of sequins, washers, and printed ephemera.
work.composition: bilateral symmetry along central vertical axis
keywords: vinyl record compact disc layered collage
